paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Ulla, Shabbat 66a: bar Rav Ulla. He sat before Rav Chisda, there 54b; Abaye said. Rabbi Yonah gave him tithe, because he labored in Torah, not because he was a priest, Jerusalem Talmud, Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 5, halakhah 5. Rav Pappa bar Acha bar Adda spoke in his name.
